name: MAPIMALA
description: Code and result tables of the article “MAPIMALA: a reproducible low-compute benchmark of neural classifiers for medicinal-plant identification from leaf images, with robustness and shortcut analysis” (Machine Vision and Applications, submitted 2026). Eight Python scripts (TensorFlow 2.21 / Keras 3) reproduce every table and figure of the paper on the public DIMPSAR dataset (5,945 images, 40 species): frozen and fine-tuned ImageNet backbones, CNN from scratch, pixel-based and GA-initialised networks, representation × classifier ablation, CPU cost, the DIMPSAR-C corruption benchmark (nine smartphone-acquisition corruptions at three severities, regenerated with fixed seeds) and the Grad-CAM / masking shortcut analysis. The stratified 70/10/20 split and every result file of the paper are included. Trained models, frozen features, leaf masks, predictions and the SHA-256 checksums of DIMPSAR-C are in the companion data record (10.5281/zenodo.23418954).
